Theme

Latin word

impōnō

impōnō, impōnere, imposuī, impositum

verb, third conjugation: the thing in the accusative, the person in the dative

lay on, impose (a burden, a task, a law, a tax); put on: upload

In this lexicon

  • impose

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 13.11.1: nē magnum onus observantiae Brūtō nostrō impōnerem (Lewis & Short); Cic. Phil. 7.15: lēgēs cīvitātī per vim imposuit (Lewis & Short); Traupman 180: vectīgal impōnere

  • upload

    the recommended word · * our formation
